name: Arma 2: Operation Arrowhead (Wine)
author: adam@dukemotorsports.net
description: Arma 2: Operation Arrowhead dedicated server running the Windows build under Wine, using the same image, Wine prefix and supervisord setup as pridit-a2oa/docker-arma2oaserver-wine. Requires a Steam account that owns the game; Steam Guard is approved by push notification during install. Needs three UDP ports: the primary allocation (game), +1 (Steam query), +2 (Steam).

variables.name: Steam Username
variables.description: Steam account that owns Arma 2: Operation Arrowhead (and Arma 2 for Combined Operations). Anonymous login cannot download this game.

variables.name: Steam Password
variables.description: Password for the Steam account. No Steam Guard code is used: approve the push notification in the Steam mobile app while the server installs. Reinstall to update the game.

variables.name: Arma 2 Content (Combined Operations)
variables.description: Also download Arma 2 and merge its AddOns and Dta folders into the OA install. 0 = OA only, 33900 = Arma 2 bought on Steam, 33910 = Arma 2 (RoW). Reinstall after changing.

variables.name: Steam Beta Branch
variables.description: Optional SteamCMD beta branch for Operation Arrowhead (app 33930). Leave empty for the default branch.

variables.name: Params File
variables.description: Launch parameters file to start with, relative to the server folder (passed as -par=). Keep one per setup, e.g. params_dayz and params_life, and switch here. The Steam ports are written into the server config that file names with -config=.

variables.name: Headless Client
variables.description: Run the local ArmA2OA.exe client on a second virtual display that connects to the server, as the reference supervisord.conf does. true or false.
